title: Forces and Newton’s Laws
summary: Grade 9: balanced and unbalanced forces, inertia, Newton’s three laws, momentum and its conservation, and gravity, mass and weight.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Three simple laws connect force, mass and motion, letting us design safer vehicles, launch rockets and send spacecraft to other worlds.

factual: How are force, mass and acceleration related?
What is momentum, and when is it conserved?
conceptual: Why do action and reaction forces not cancel each other out?
Why does an airbag reduce the force in a crash?
debatable: Should every car sold in India have six airbags?
Is it fair to call Newton's laws 'laws' when Einstein later improved on them?
